PDFs are rotated entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server. Only each page's rotation changes — text, images and links stay exactly as they were. Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first.

How Rotate PDF works

Upload

Drop a PDF file — it never leaves your device.

Rotate

Turn single pages left or right, or rotate every page at once.

Download

Save the PDF with every page facing the right way.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is my PDF uploaded to a server?

No. MediaPilot rotates the pages entirely in your browser. Your PDF never leaves your device.

Will rotating reduce the quality?

No. Only each page's rotation setting changes. The text stays selectable and images keep their full quality.

Can I rotate just one page?

Yes. Use the ↺ and ↻ buttons under any page. Pages you rotate are outlined in blue and show which way they will turn.

Is the rotation permanent?

Yes. The saved PDF opens with the pages turned in every PDF reader. Your original file is not changed.
